nodes.label: Form D-004: income of each person, housing and utility spending
No survey weights: shares are shares of the sample; no national counts or sums
No food spending (form D-003): no food price shock and no consumption-based poverty
Poverty here is measured by money income, not by consumption
Official poverty statistics are based on consumption, so levels are not comparable
Repeated cross-sections without a panel: households differ between years
Only forms D-008 and D-004 feed the calculations; D-002, D-006 and T-001 are not linked
Static model: no behavioural response; full take-up unless stated
The main earner's employment type is approximated by the wage share of the household's labour income
Regional subsistence minimums are Bureau of National Statistics annual values; the 2022 regional values are rebuilt from monthly data with the Bureau's method
